service.method: SELECT SIAD.SUBJECT AS DOC_SUBJECT , SIAD.SMR_NUMBER , SIAD.SMR_STATUS , SIAD.RE_FLAG , SIAD.ADD_USER_ID , SIAD.ADD_DATE , SIAD.ADD_TIME , SIAD.CHANGE_DATE , SIAD.CHANGE_TIME , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.EMAIL , DATEDIFF(DAY, SIAD.CHANGE_DATE, GETDATE()) AS COUNT_DAY FROM SSIAD SIAD INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND SIAD.COMPANY_CODE = USMT.COMPANY_CODE AND SIAD.ADD_USER_ID = USMT.USER_ID WHERE SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SIAD.RE_FLAG = 'R' AND SIAD.SMR_STATUS IN ('C', 'DR') AND DATEDIFF(DAY, SIAD.CHANGE_DATE, GETDATE()) >= #{COUNT_DAY} AND (DATEDIFF(DAY, SIAD.CHANGE_DATE, GETDATE()) % 3 ) = 0 ORDER BY SIAD.SMR_NUMBER DESC
